notes.title: New Game -Dystobel-
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

I haven't posted anything here for a while.

I want to let you know that my new [b]Dystobel[/b] game is coming soon.

It's been years with this new project, trying to apply what I learned with Kuniture to create a new game that improves what I did in the first game.

If you liked Kuniture and now want to try something from the same author (and with a much more accessible difficulty) I invite you to add [b]Dystobel[/b] to your [b]wish list.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328990/Dystobel/

That would help me a lot at launch time.

You can also follow me on twitter to chat and see what's new in the title: https://twitter.com/KenDavisDev

Greetings and thanks for your support. :)

notes.title: New Difficulty
notes.content:
I have read many of your comments and I have added a new difficulty, now after seeing the story in a new game you can choose between the difficulties:

-Difficult: It is the original version, with the same challenge that the game has always had.
-Normal: The new difficulty, much more accessible, more carrots, more save points, less enemies, among others.

I hope that this way the game can be enjoyed by more people and they can take advantage of it to play during the world quarantine. Greetings and stay home.

-Ken Davis
